Vesktop has a setting "Share window" via `--enable-features` or better: Vesktop supports `window` sharing through the portal if `xdg-desktop-portal` and a backend that supports windows (e.g., `xdg-desktop-portal-wlr` with newer version supports window sharing? Known fix for Discord window sharing on Wayland: 
- For Vesktop: enable "Share window" via settings? Vesktop uses `getDisplays`/`getWindows` via Electron desktopCapturer which on Linux needs `--enable-features=WebRTCPipeWireCapturer` (older) or newer Electron uses PipeWire by default. Actually Electron's desktopCapturer on Wayland needs the PipeWire capturer. Vesktop ships with `-enable-features=WaylandWindowDecorations`? Let me recall: Vencord/Vesktop docs: to get screen share working on Wayland, you need `xdg-desktop-portal` + a portal backend (e.g., xdg-desktop-portal-wlr) and run Vesktop with `--enable-features=WebRTCPipeWireCapturer --enable-wayland-ime`? For regular Discord (web version in browser) it needs PipeWire + portals too. Native Discord doesn't support Wayland screenshare; it's X11 only, so on Wayland it goes through XWayland and only shows full X11 screen... Actually native Discord running under XWayland can only share XWayland windows (its own window) or entire X11 root. Typically people can share individual windows on XWayland?
